ultrawide_sensor: 50 MP ultrawide AF; 108MP OIS+EIS main; 4K60 front+rear, GoPro mode
notes: India launch Sep 18 2024 (Flipkart, sale Sep 21). 50MP 120deg-FOV UW officially advertised. Android 15 (XOS 15) delivered Aug-Sep 2025; eligible for Android 16 (XOS 16) + 36mo security. Best-spec'd Infinix UW in India. ARCore CERTIFIED ('Zero 40' on Google's official device list per recon extraction) - upgrades IMU/timestamp from the input's blanket HIGH risk to moderate/likely-OK.
caveats: Strongest Infinix candidate: ARCore certified (Google-calibrated camera-IMU timing), 120deg 50MP AF ultrawide officially advertised, vlogging/GoPro-mode marketing implies the UW is a first-class video lens, 4nm Dimensity 8200 should sustain 1080p30 for 25 min easily. Two real unknowns keep it off Supported: (1) Transsion HALs have no public record of exposing the UW to third-party Camera2 (zoom-ratio <1.0 or separate ID) - if the runtime probe fails, the device fails the compat-check outright; (2) Dimensity 8200 encoder sits in the 'mixed' MTK bucket - WebRTC forces framerate-adjustment for MTK encoders (timestamps ignored by rate control), so CBR compliance and stamp regularity need on-device verification before promotion. Recommend this as the one Infinix to buy for bench validation.
